newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent untraded, but quotes edge up on NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent untraded, but quotes edge up on NYMEX.

text.p: Brent crude futures were untraded by late trading in Asia on Monday but quotes moved higher in line with a slightly firmer tone on NYMEX.
January Brent futures were quoted on SIMEX at $23.04/$23.15 per barrel at 0920 GMT, just above the London settlement of $23.03 and higher than earlier quotes of $22.90/$23.00.
January NYMEX futures prices on the after-hours ACCESS system pulled back to a last trade of $23.78 per barrel by late afternoon Asian time versus $23.70 earlier in the day.
The contract closed at $23.75 in New York on Friday.
Brokers said volume was modest and there was no fresh news behind the move.

However, they said they expected the cold weather worries for the U.S. and Europe to keep the market supported, although fears the Iraq/United Nations oil deal was close to being implemented was undermining the support.
In addition, the OPEC meeting this week in Vienna was likely to keep many players on hold, leaving Brent futures to range trade.
